question: What capacity did the 1.4 Ah pouch cell keep after its cycling and over how many cycles, and by what percentage did the lithium content of the NMC622 fall on delamination?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE regexp_matches(lower(text), '1\.4 ?ah|pouch|lithium content|li content|retain|retention|cycles') ORDER BY page, id
SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE (page=2 AND id IN ('p2.L99','p2.L100')) OR (page=5 AND id BETWEEN 'p5.L63' AND 'p5.L70') OR (page=2 AND id BETWEEN 'p2.L131' AND 'p2.L136') ORDER BY id

WITH v AS (SELECT CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM lines WHERE id='p5.L66'), '([0-9]+\.[0-9]+)', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS before_li, CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM lines WHERE id='p5.L67'), 'to ([0-9]+\.[0-9]+)', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS after_li) SELECT (before_li - after_li) / before_li * 100 AS pct_fall, before_li, after_li FROM v

door_refusals.why: your own words contain number(s) ['1.4'] — a number must come from the document, in digits or in words
moves: '1.4' is written exactly so in the document (e.g. p2.L97): if that is what you mean (a name like this, or that value), quote it: {"quote": "1.4", "atom": "p2.L97"} — never shorten it
move each number into a quote run: {"quote": "<exact characters>", "atom": "<id>"}
or compute it in a sql run (counts, sums, conversions)
or say it without a number ("several", "a", "each")

door_refusals.why: a SELECT without FROM reads no atom, so its value has no source
moves: read the value from the relation that holds it

runs.text: . The lithium content of the NMC622 cathode fell from

runs.sql: SELECT (CAST(regexp_extract(b.text, '([0-9]+\.[0-9]+)', 1) AS DOUBLE) - CAST(regexp_extract(a.text, 'to ([0-9]+\.[0-9]+)', 1) AS DOUBLE)) / CAST(regexp_extract(b.text, '([0-9]+\.[0-9]+)', 1) AS DOUBLE) * 100 AS pct_fall FROM lines b, lines a WHERE b.id='p5.L66' AND a.id='p5.L67'
